app.name: Arclight
app.offlineHelp: You're offline. Downloads still play; your listening progress is saved and sent when you're back online.
app.nav.label: Sections
app.welcome.title: Your movies, shows, music and audiobooks, from your own server
app.welcome.body: Arclight plays the movies, shows, music and audiobooks on your Arclight server, at home or on the go, and keeps music and books downloaded for offline listening.
app.welcome.scanHelp: In Arclight on the web, open the player, then your account menu → Sign in to the Arclight app.
app.addServer.title: Connect to a server
app.addServer.insecure: This server is on the internet without HTTPS. Your password and listening would travel unencrypted.
app.addServer.needsSetup: This Arclight server is not set up yet. Finish setup in a browser first.
app.addServer.error.invalid: That doesn't look like a server address.
app.addServer.error.unreachable: Couldn't reach {host}. Check the address and that this phone is on the right network.
app.addServer.error.tls: {host} has a certificate this phone doesn't trust.
app.addServer.error.not-arclight: {host} answered, but it isn't an Arclight server.
app.addServer.error.cors: {host} refused the app. Update Arclight on the server.
app.scan.instructions: Point the camera at the pairing code shown in Arclight
app.scan.notPairing: That QR code isn't an Arclight pairing code.
app.scan.failed: Couldn't scan. Allow camera access for Arclight in the system settings, or enter the address instead.
app.signIn.title: Sign in
app.signIn.totpHint: Six digits from your authenticator app.
app.signIn.passwordInstead: Sign in with a password instead
app.signIn.pairHint: The 8-character code under the QR code in Arclight on the web (ABCD-EFGH).
app.signIn.error.totp-required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
app.signIn.error.totp-invalid: That code didn't work. Try the next one.
app.signIn.error.rate-limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
app.signIn.error.pair-invalid: That pair code isn't valid. Make a new one in Arclight on the web.
app.signIn.error.pair-expired: That pair code has expired. Make a new one in Arclight on the web.
app.signIn.error.player-disabled: The player is turned off on this server. An admin can turn it on in Settings → Player.
app.signIn.error.player-not-allowed: This account isn't allowed to use the player. Ask the server's admin.
app.signIn.error.pairing-required: This server only lets the app in with a pairing code. In Arclight on the web, open the player, then your account menu → Sign in to the Arclight app.
app.signIn.error.two-factor-setup: Turn on two-factor sign-in for this account in a browser first, then sign in here.
app.signIn.expired: You were signed out of {server}. Sign in again to keep listening.
app.downloads.title: Downloads
app.downloads.emptyHelp: Download what's playing or your queue to listen without a connection.
app.downloads.unavailable: Downloads need the latest Arclight app on this phone.
app.downloads.removeAllConfirm: Remove every download from this phone? You can download them again later.
app.downloads.error.storage-limit: That would go over the storage limit in Settings.
app.downloads.error.no-space: Not enough free space on this phone.
app.downloads.error.unavailable: Downloads need the latest Arclight app on this phone.
app.queue.title: Queue
app.settings.title: Settings
app.settings.signOutConfirm: Sign out of {server}? Its downloads stay on this phone until you remove them.
app.settings.qualityHint: Original plays the file as it is. AAC asks the server to convert it, which uses less data.
app.settings.reportProgressHint: Sends what you play and where you stopped to your server, so you can pick up on another device.
app.settings.pending: {count, plural, one {# progress update waiting to be sent} other {# progress updates waiting to be sent}}
app.player.off: The player isn't available for this account.
app.player.offHelp: The player may be turned off on the server, or this account may not be allowed to use it.
app.tv.welcomeHelp: Then confirm a code on your phone or computer, no typing a password with the remote.
app.tv.code.open: On your phone or computer, open
app.tv.code.enter: Sign in there if asked, then enter this code (or scan the QR code):
app.tv.code.label: Sign-in code
app.tv.code.qr: QR code that opens the confirm page with the code filled in
app.tv.code.expired: The code expired. Get a new one to keep going.
app.tv.code.instead: Sign in with a code instead
app.tv.manage.pinMismatch: The PINs did not match. Try again.
app.tv.myListEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Open any title and choose My List to keep it here.
app.tv.pin.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
app.tv.settings.audiobooksDesc: Shows Audiobooks in the top bar and a Continue Listening row on Home.
app.tv.settings.autoplayNextDesc: Starts the next episode when one ends.
app.tv.settings.heroRotateDesc: The banner on Home moves to the next title every few seconds.
app.tv.settings.libraryIntro: Movies and TV are always on. Music and Audiobooks sit next to Settings in the top bar; hide them here if you don’t use them.
app.tv.settings.musicDesc: Shows Music in the top bar and a Recently Played row on Home.
app.settings.deviceDesc: Accounts, streaming, downloads, privacy and language
app.tv.settings.playbackIntro: These apply to this TV only.
app.tv.settings.qualityDesc: Auto picks the best quality your connection can hold.
app.tv.settings.reduceMotionDesc: Turns off fades and smooth scrolling.
app.tv.settings.subtitleLanguageDesc: Used when a title starts. You can change it during playback.
app.error.serverTimeout: {host} didn't answer within {seconds} seconds. Check that the server is running and that this device is on the right network.
app.error.serverUnreachable: Couldn't reach {host}. Check that the server is running and that this device is on the right network.
